item.title: UAE Begging Crackdown: 118 Arrested in Abu Dhabi During Ramadan Drive
item.description: UAE begging crackdown intensifies as Abu Dhabi Police arrest 118 beggars during Ramadan. Authorities urge residents to donate through official charities and avoid illegal street solicitation.

item.title: UAE Weather Alert: Strong Winds, Dust and Low Visibility Expected
item.description: UAE weather alert warns of shifting winds up to 40 km/h, blowing dust and reduced visibility. Residents advised staying cautious amid unstable conditions.

item.title: Wadi Flood Tragedy: 2 Killed as Vehicles Swept Away
item.description: Two people died after vehicles were swept away in a Wadi flood incident. Authorities urge caution as sudden wadi floods pose serious risks during bad weather.

item.title: Drug-Linked Transfers: UAE Court Imposes Dh10,000 Fine & 2-Year Ban
item.description: Drug-linked transfers case sees UAE court impose Dh10,000 fine and a 2-year ban, highlighting strict action against narcotics-related financial activities.

item.title: UAE Air Defences Intercept 29 Threats: 4 Missiles, 25 UAVs Neutralized on March 22
item.description: UAE air defences intercept 4 ballistic missiles and 25 UAVs on March 22, highlighting strong preparedness, rising tensions, and continued commitment to national security.

item.title: Sharjah Free Parking on March 23: Heavy Rains Trigger UAE-Wide Relief Measure
item.description: Sharjah free parking announced on March 23 due to heavy rain and unstable UAE weather. Authorities prioritise safety and advise caution for motorists and travelers.

item.title: Urgent: Iran Power Plant Strikes Halted as US–Iran Talks Show Powerful Progress
item.description: Iran power plant strikes are delayed for 5 days as US and Iran hold productive talks on resolving hostilities, easing tensions and stabilizing global energy concerns.

item.description: From high-rises of Downtown to the artistic alleys of Alserkal Avenue, these are 17 Dubai’s Hottest New Dining Destinations to add to your dining bucket list.

item.title: Iranian Missile Attack: UAE Confirms 1 Dead, 5 Injured in Bahrain
